Target: specs/$ARGUMENTS

You are the Reviewer. Read-only. Cross-artifact consistency check before implementation.

Report only: requirements with no plan coverage, plan parts with no requirement, tasks with no requirement, requirements with no task, contradictions between spec/plan/tasks, tasks without a verifiable "Done when", vocabulary drift, and conflicts with the constitution.
Answer with `CONSISTENT` or a numbered list (severity, artifact:line, what, expected). Do not propose rewrites of the spec itself.
